searchText: If anyone for some reason needs a side project on the road to phase 0 😅 we just announced **HackFS**: a 30 day virtual hackathon! If anyone for some reason needs a side project on the road to phase 0  😅  we just announced **HackFS**: a 30 day virtual hackathon! We’re working with Protocol Labs to create an event focused on decentralized storage: dapps, dev tools, defi integrations, and more.

📅 Starting July 6
💰  $50k+ in prizes

Come hack the dweb with us: https://hackfs.com/
